summary: Saga Communications filed an 8-K announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share on its Class A Common Stock, payable June 12, 2026, to holders of record May 22, 2026. The aggregate payment is approximately $1.6 million, funded from cash on hand. The board retains discretion over future dividends and any stock buyback program. This is a routine capital-return event within a regular dividend policy, not a special situation. What to watch: any change in dividend pattern or introduction of a share repurchase program.
